outputs.display_value: cyclo-hexamer of alternating 3,5-bis(4-amidophenyl)benzaldehyde corners and 2,3,5,6-tetrafluoroterephthaloyl linkers; smallest repeat C27H14F4N2O3
outputs.raw_value: For i in Z/6Z, A_i is OHC-1,3,5-C6H3(-p-C6H4-NH-)2 and B_i is -CO-(2,3,5,6-F4-1,4-C6)-CO-; connect A_i.right-NH to B_i.left-C(O) and B_i.right-C(O) to A_(i+1).left-NH. The primitive open sector A_i+B_i is C27H14F4N2O3 and the closed six-sector ring is C162H84F24N12O18.
